resources.string: Keep a foreground watchdog and attempt to restart Shizuku after an unexpected exit. A manual stop pauses recovery until the next manual start, or reboot with start on boot enabled.

Use ADB TCP port 5555 on the next start. Wi-Fi is needed once after each reboot; later recovery can work without Wi-Fi. Keep USB debugging enabled. Only accept debugging prompts you initiated. Disabling this switch does not close an existing TCP port; reboot to close it.
Monitoring Shizuku. Unexpected exits will trigger a recovery attempt.
Waiting for Wi-Fi. Wireless startup requires an authorized Wi-Fi network.
Shizuku is unavailable. Retrying with backoff; sleep may delay recovery.
Automatic recovery needs your help. Open Shizuku, check debugging authorization and pairing, then start manually. Retries may also have reached their limit.
Automatic recovery needs your attention. Open Shizuku.
